title: thelypteris puberula
intro: Thelypteris puberula, commonly known as the Dwarf Lady Fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris puberula include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
